views.name: chunk_view_2
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  hfsm.product_code,
  hfsm.sold_quantity,
  hfsm.fiscal_year
FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly AS hfsm
WHERE hfsm.fiscal_year = 2021
ORDER BY hfsm.sold_quantity DESC
LIMIT 3
views.description:
Task: Calculate the average quantity sold for the top three best-selling hardware products within each division for the calendar year 2021, considering only sales data from that year.
Required outputs
counter_examples: Which university faculty members' salaries are closest to the average salary for their respective ranks? Please provide the ranks, first names, last names, and salaries.university

views.name: top_sales_reps_per_region
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.region_id AS region,
  r.name AS sales_rep,
  SUM(wo.total_amt_usd) AS total_sales_amount
FROM web_sales_reps AS r
JOIN web_accounts AS a
  ON r.region_id = a.id
JOIN web_orders AS wo
  ON a.id = wo.account_id
GROUP BY
  r.region_id,
  r.name
views.description: Ranks sales representatives by total sales within each region, including ties.

views.name: company_salaries_by_city
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    sd.CompanyName AS company_name,
    sd.Location AS city,
    AVG(sd.SalariesReported) AS average_salary
FROM
    SalaryDataset sd
GROUP BY
    sd.CompanyName,
    sd.Location
views.description: Calculate average salaries for each company in each city.

views.name: top_companies_by_salary
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    sd.CompanyName AS company_name,
    sd.Location AS city,
    AVG(sd.SalariesReported) AS average_salary,
    AVG(sd.SalariesReported) AS average_salary_national
FROM
    SalaryDataset sd
GROUP BY
    sd.CompanyName,
    sd.Location
ORDER BY
    average_salary DESC
LIMIT 5
views.description: Rank companies by average salary in each city, then filter to top 5.
